title: pool_acquire: leaked slot reservation when recovery open fails under lock contention
description: In crypto2dev_pool_acquire(), when the fast path finds no ready fd and falls into the recovery_slot path: the slot is marked in_use=1 outside the lock, then open() is called without the lock. If open() fails, in_use is reset to 0 (correct). However: a concurrent thread that also entered crypto2dev_pool_acquire() and found all slots in_use (including the recovery slot which was in_use=1 at that moment) will have returned fd=-1 and reported WC_HW_E — a spurious error. The recovery slot's 'in_use=1 while open is in flight' window is a transient false exhaustion. This is low probability but real: under load with exactly 'capacity' threads acquiring simultaneously, all threads but one see a full pool for the duration of the open() syscall.
